name: MagicLab MagicDog T1
summary: A 19 kg IP54 quadruped for one-person deployment on inspection and light transport jobs, with 15 kg continuous payload; MagicLab has shown it with a rear gripper arm.

germany.statusNote: Launched in August 2026 and shown at IFA Berlin, but MagicLab has no product page or offer for it yet; European use is only announced as a plan (hospital transport). MagicLab states CE-RED certification is targeted for Q4 2026; check the CE marking before use in Germany.

notes: A rear-mounted gripper arm was shown at WAIC 2026 as an add-on; it is not counted here because no configuration with arm is offered.
Runtime, speed and stair ability not published.

images.alt: MagicDog T1 with the add-on rear gripper arm picking up a bottle at the WAIC 2026 demo

evidence.task: Patrols a zone, finds plastic bottles and picks them up with a rear gripper arm

sources.title: MagicLab Brings Physical AI to Europe's Factory Floors at IFA 2026

openQuestions: Price, runtime and sales start in Europe.
No product page yet; the only official image shows the T1 with its add-on gripper arm at WAIC 2026.
